units.source_text: 我和K商量暑假上哪儿去玩玩，他表示哪儿也不想去。

en.t: I talked with K about where we might go during summer vacation, but he indicated that he did not want to go anywhere.

units.source_text: 当然他也并不是想去哪儿就可以去哪儿的身份。

en.t: Of course, he was not in a position where he could simply go wherever he pleased.

units.source_text: 不过只要我邀请，他也是想去哪儿都可以拔腿就走的。

en.t: Still, as long as I invited him, he could set off at once for any place he wanted to go.
I asked him why he did not want to go.

units.source_text: 他说也没什么理由，只是觉得在家里看书更自由自在。

en.t: He said there was no particular reason, only that he felt freer staying at home and reading.

units.source_text: 我提议去避暑胜地那样的凉爽地方学习更有益于身体，他却说，既然那样，你就一个人去好了。

en.t: I suggested that studying in a cool place like a summer resort would be better for his health, but he said that in that case I should go by myself.

units.source_text: 但是，我不想让他独自留在家里，看到他同家里人日渐亲近，我就已经感到不痛快了。

en.t: But I did not want to leave him at home alone, and I was already uneasy at seeing him grow closer day by day to the people of the house.

units.source_text: 如果有人说，你最初的愿望已经达到，为什么心里还这样不舒服呢？我真是无言以对。

en.t: If someone had said that my original wish had been fulfilled and asked why I still felt so uncomfortable, I would truly have had no answer.
I was undoubtedly a great fool.

units.source_text: 见我们两人商量个没完，夫人实在看不下去了，便过来劝解。

en.t: Seeing the two of us go on discussing it without end, the lady of the house could no longer stand by and came over to mediate.

units.source_text: 最终，我们决定一起去房州。

en.t: In the end, we decided to go to Boshu together.

units.source_text: 1.斯威登堡（1688—1772）：瑞典科学家、神秘主义者、哲学家和神学家。

en.t: 1. Swedenborg (1688-1772): a Swedish scientist, mystic, philosopher, and theologian.

units.source_text: 2.房州：日本古代安房国的别称，千叶县的古国名。

en.t: 2. Boshu: another name for ancient Awa Province in Japan, an old provincial name in Chiba Prefecture.
